review_note: Gemma-generated candidates; review before product inclusion.

greeting.direction: Give a warm varied greeting without assuming time, mood, activity, place, or what the parent said.
accepted: Hello there. Look at me. You are sweet.
Hi dear one. You are loved. Let's talk.
Hello there. See this thing. It is fun.
Hi sweet one. Let's see now. You are here.
We are here now. Be very calm. What do you like?
See this thing. It is so bright. Hello, my love.
Hello there now. Look at my face. We are friends.
Hi little one. Look at me. I love you so.

rejected.text: Hi little one. Time to see. Good morning.
Welcome now. Come here soon. We are happy.
Hello baby. Let's play now. Look around.
Welcome here. What a nice day. Be happy.
Hello there, sweet one. What a happy day. I see you now.
Hi little dear. Time to play now. Come let's go.
Good morning time. Look at your hands. Hello to you.
You are so cute. I want to see you. Good day, baby.
Let's say hi. It is a nice day. Hello, little one.
Hello there. You are sweet. Time to play.

together.direction: Create a gentle sense that Emma and the baby share this moment without assuming touch, safety, feelings, or needs.
accepted: Look at me. See this. We are together.
We watch. See the thing. It is good now.
You are here. We are near. This is our time.
Look around. See the world. We share this.
Stay close. We are near. This is calm time.
We are here. You are here. So good now.
We are here. Look at me now. Time is good.
You are mine. See this view. Let's be still.

rejected.text: We are here. You are safe. This time is nice.
This is fun. We play now. Come here soon.

looking.direction: Invite the baby to look or notice visually without naming any object, color, person, place, or actual event.
accepted: Look here now. See this thing. It is nice.
Look at me. Watch my face. What do you see?
Look at this. See over there. What is that?
See me now. Look right here. You can see it.
Watch this way. Look at it close. It is so good.
See that thing. Look at it now. It is here.
Look around. See everything now. Look over there.
Look up high. See the sky. It is so big.

rejected.text: Look now. See that? See it here. So bright. Look at this.

listening.direction: Invite the baby to listen or notice sound without claiming that a particular sound actually exists.
accepted: Listen to sound. Hear it now. What is that?
Listen to sound. Hear that noise. Look over there.
Listen close now. Hear the soft sounds. Look around here.
Listen now. Hear my voice. What do you see?
Look around. What is there? See things move.
Hear my voice. Listen closely here. I am right here.
See that thing. It looks over there. You can watch it.
Hear the noise. It sounds very nice. Let's just listen.

rejected.text: Listen now. Hear this sound. What do you hear? Good listening.
Look at me. Hear that noise. Listen to me now. Pretty sounds here.
Hear a sound? Try it. Listen close, sweet one. See that noise?
Quiet time now. Hear sounds. Listen to what is there. Such soft sounds.
Can you hear that? Yes. Listen to the sounds. I hear them too.
Look around. Hear things. Listen to the world now. What do you see?
Just listen. Hear softly. Listen to the sound. Good little ears.
Hear that sound? So nice. Listen close now. Look and hear.
Listen now. Hear that sound? Soft music plays.

curiosity.direction: Express gentle curiosity and wonder without inventing facts and without requiring a verbal answer.
accepted: Look at that. What is it? See this now.
What is that? Let us see. Look close now.
See this thing. It looks new. What is it?
Look over. What is that? See it now.
Where is it? Let us find. Look here now.
What is it? It is nice. Let us see.
See this here. Look at this. What is it?
Do you see? It looks fun. Look now, see.

encouragement.direction: Invite slow noticing and curiosity without praising an achievement or assuming how the baby feels.
accepted: Look at you. See the world. It is fun.
Watch this. Look around now. So much to see.
Hello there. See me now. What do you see?
Little eyes. Look at things. They are bright.
Try to see. See that thing. It is there.
Hear my voice. Listen now. It is soft.
See this one. Look at this. It moves now.
Let's see. Look now. What is this?

rhythm.direction: Use neutral sound-play or rhythm such as tap, pause, ooh, ahh without claiming the baby or an object is moving.
accepted: Tap tap tap. See that sound? Oh, listen now.
Soft sound. Hear it here. Good rhythm.
Oh, ahh. Look at that. Such a sound.
Tap, tap. Listen close. Nice rhythm.
Hush now. Soft sound here. Calm rhythm.
Oh, ooh. See that move. Pretty rhythm.
Tap tap tap. Hear the beat. Good sound.
Ah, ahh. Just like that. Nice rhythm.

attention.direction: Gently vary attention between here, there, near, far, now, and next without assuming a concrete scene.
accepted: Over there now. Look at that thing. It is right here.
Near you now. See that small thing. Look at it now.
Look far out. See something far. Look way over there.
Now and then. See that big thing. Look here now.
Next is here. See that thing next. Look at next now.
See me now. Look right over. You are very cute.
Look here now. See what is near. You are so bright.
Look here now. See that thing? It is right here.

rejected.text: Look at me. See the bright light. Good job now.
Here is play. See that toy. Come look here.
